title: Why a Higher Salary Doesn't Always Make You Richer
recommendedTitle: Why a Higher Salary Doesn't Always Make You Richer
alternativeTitles: The Salary Trap: Why Earning More Doesn't Fix Your Savings
Why a ₹10,000 Raise Leaves Most People with ₹0 Extra
description:
Most people assume that earning more money automatically solves their financial stress. But for millions of earners, a significant salary bump results in exactly zero extra savings at the end of the year.

In this breakdown, we examine lifestyle inflation—the psychological mechanism that quietly converts income raises into higher fixed living expenses—and how the 50/50 rule protects your financial future.
